name: blender-pilot
description: A focused Blender workspace powered by Codex and MCP

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/build-notices.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json
scripts.test: node --import tsx scripts/with-postgres.ts -- node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:deploy && npm run build
scripts.verify:blender: node --import tsx scripts/with-postgres.ts -- node --import tsx scripts/verify-blender.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts tests docs README.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md compose*.yaml
scripts.verify:workspaces: node --import tsx scripts/with-postgres.ts -- node --import tsx scripts/verify-workspaces.ts
scripts.verify:chat: node --import tsx scripts/with-postgres.ts -- node --import tsx scripts/verify-chat.ts
scripts.verify:templates: node --import tsx scripts/with-postgres.ts -- node --import tsx scripts/verify-templates.ts
scripts.verify:journeys: node --import tsx scripts/with-postgres.ts -- node --import tsx scripts/verify-journeys.ts
scripts.verify:interface: node --import tsx scripts/with-postgres.ts -- node --import tsx scripts/verify-interface.ts
scripts.verify:skills: node --import tsx scripts/with-postgres.ts -- node --import tsx scripts/verify-skills.ts
